finding: The ACP request remained blocked in session/prompt after the last native tool event; provider request admissions continued to request 745/750 while no tool event occurred for more than the authorized 300-second stall bound. The harness did not cancel because its stall watcher reset on every session/update, including streamed message chunks. The attempt was interrupted with SIGINT after the bound, producing KeyboardInterrupt in the ACP selector; no final receipt or verifier result exists. There were 636 completed tool calls with no unpaired event and over 43 minutes of observed tool work before the final stall, but qualification cannot be claimed.
